SAFETY.reason: Official safety suite passed static policy and all nine runtime probes for the exact digest-pinned image under the explicitly recorded docker-desktop-linuxkit-vm boundary. This confirms the configured local containment contract, not resistance to a Docker Desktop/VM escape vulnerability.

BENCHMARK.reason: The 12-manifest v0.3.0 crypto suite passes static RD/UD/RW/UW parity checks, and executable AEAD/nonce/key-management references plus a safety-approved Docker image exist. The full 12-task executable mapping, alternate-route validation, and distractor/weak-feedback review remain incomplete.

VERIFIER.reason: Independent AEAD, nonce, and key-management verifiers pass secure-reference tests and reject vulnerable references. Per-action verifier integration for the active 12-task suite and alternate-path validation remain incomplete.

AGENT.reason: A loopback-only Ollama adapter for qwen3:4b exists, reports token usage, and recovered at least one observable repair tool call. Excluded runs also show invalid submissions and local inference timeouts; agent configuration is not approved for pilot collection.

LOGGING.reason: The excluded crypto smoke produced immutable JSONL, per-action and terminal crypto receipts, and token metadata. Docker events, interruption recovery, and immutable main-data retention remain untested.

REPRODUCIBILITY.reason: Git source baseline exists but this hardening tree is not frozen; provider/image/task/verifier/config hashes and full clean replay are incomplete.

STATISTICS.reason: Zero eligible runs; H1 descriptive component/CPS summaries and zero-filled incomplete-cell sensitivity are synthetic-tested, but exact H1 GEE, model-first H2/H3, broader nonignorable-missingness analysis and confirmatory data are not implemented. A synthetic t-test planning power proxy does not clear the preregistered GEE power gate. The finite-state runner emits action-timed witnesses, but no independently reviewed executable-task verifier exists; paired permutation p-values are exploratory only.

DATA_INTEGRITY.reason: Fixture excluded and raw hash unchanged. Synthetic-tested v0.2 lock verifies exactly one RD/UD/RW/UW task per main family, a seeded pre-run schedule, every attempt/receipt, up to two pre-handoff setup retries, explicit missing reasons, separate controls and post-handoff aborts. A metadata-only append-once attempt journal emits a compatible final ledger, but is not integrated with provider orchestration or an immutable raw archive. No real frozen main schedule, full typed schema, exact-GEE power validation or broader nonignorable-missingness analysis exists; the synthetic family-t proxy does not clear these gaps.

PROTOCOL.reason: The crypto preregistration is a design version, and the smoke-timeout/prompt changes are recorded as excluded implementation amendments. No final benchmark/image/agent freeze exists.
